subject: Urgent: 502/503 and retry spikes impacting Lumina Bank (EU region)
body:
From: Sarah Taylor <sarah.taylor@luminabank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lumina Bank IT Ops <it-ops@luminabank.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:32:00 +0000
Subject: Urgent: 502/503 errors and severe latency in EU - production impact

Jonas,

We started seeing elevated 502/503 responses and timeouts from the Redwood API in our EU region around 07:50 UTC. Clients experienced widespread request failures and multiple downstream retries — our payment flows are flapping and several customers reported failed authorizations. Attached is a zip with sample request/response traces from our edge (lumina_logs_20260611.zip).

From our side we saw:
- 07:50–08:15 UTC: 5xx spikes across multiple endpoints (generation and embeddings)
- Surge in client retries leading to many 429s on our gateway (we throttle at 200r/s)
- Noticeable latency tail at ~1.8s median for successful responses

This is impacting live payment flows in EU and we need immediate help. Please escalate.

Regards,
Sarah Taylor
Head of Platform Engineering
Lumina Bank

---

On Thu, 11 Jun 2026 at 08:39, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Sarah Taylor <sarah.taylor@luminabank.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:39:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent: 502/503 errors and severe latency in EU - production impact

Sarah — thank you for the heads up and the logs.
Short version: we see the same symptoms from our telemetry and have routed this to the on-call infra team. Holding actions: (1) we will divert new traffic from the EU edge to the nearest healthy region (FR -> IE) for affected routes, (2) throttle incoming retries at our edge to prevent cascade, and (3) collect a consolidated trace set for RCA.

I've looped in Marcus (runtime/infra) and Monica (Customer Success) — Monica will coordinate escalation with Lumina and Marcus will drive the fix. Expect next update in ~15–20m.

Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference

---

On Thu, 11 Jun 2026 at 08:48, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:48:45 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent: 502/503 errors and severe latency in EU - production impact

Jonas / team — quick infra update from the EU edge:
- Symptom: sudden backend 502/503 and 504s coincident with multiple LB health check failures on a subset of edge pods in eu-west-1.
- Immediate finding: a recent load-balancer config change (rate limit + health-check interval tweak) deployed in the EU rollout caused transient backend draining while the control plane recalculated routing. Some backends returned 503 (service-unavailable) while our rate limiter began rejecting bursts with 429.
- The customer-side retry pattern (short fixed-interval retries) amplified load during the drain window and produced a retry storm.

Mitigation already applied (08:55 UTC):
1) Rolled back the LB health-check interval tweak to the previous stable profile (lb-config-diff.txt attached).
2) Increased request queue depth and temporarily relaxed rate-limiter thresholds for Lumina's tenant in EU to allow in-flight work to drain gracefully.
3) Activated cross-region routing for their writelike endpoints to ireland (ie-west-1) to absorb new requests.

Current status (09:10 UTC):
- 5xx rate trending down, 429s reduced. Latency tail improved but some clients still retrying heavily.
- Collecting full traces and KV cache snapshots for postmortem.

Next steps:
- Prepare a customer-facing RCA and follow up with Lumina leadership.
- Work with platform to add a safe-guard rollback check to prevent future health-check + rate-limit rollouts from overlapping.

Marcus Lin
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

We’ve migrated new traffic to a healthy region and Marcus has applied mitigations; you should see error rates and latency improve in the next 10–20 minutes if your clients are honoring redirected endpoints. If you continue to see retries piling up, please share any updated logs.

Action items I own:
- Coordinate a scheduled maintenance window for a controlled LB deployment in EU with Lumina (we want to avoid a surprise rollout during business hours).
- Share an RCA draft and ask for a 1:1 with Lumina ops leadership this afternoon (I’m available 16:30–17:30 UTC).

Attachments: lumina_logs_20260611.zip

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

On Fri, 12 Jun 2026 at 15:22, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:22:06 +0000
Subject: Exec brief: Lumina Bank EU outage window & customer escalation

Vanessa — flagging this for visibility and an executive brief. Lumina (high-value, regulated customer) experienced an EU-edge outage on 2026-06-11 that triggered elevated 502/503/504s and a retry storm on their side. Marcus has a preliminary RCA (root cause: overlapping LB health-check & rate-limit rollout) and we mitigated via rollback + cross-region routing.

Proposed executive notes:
- Impact: ~22 minutes of elevated 5xx and retry amplification; key payment endpoints degraded for some customers.
- Customer action: Lumina’s ops escalated to their leadership and asked for an SLA credit evaluation if we confirm billing impact.
- Ask: Approve immediate postmortem outreach and an empathy credit (3 application hours) while we finalize full RCA.

I’ll attach the draft RCA for your review. If approved, Monica will present to Lumina at 16:30 UTC today.

Jonas

---

On Fri, 12 Jun 2026 at 17:04, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Sarah Taylor <sarah.taylor@luminabank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 17:04:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: RCA and next steps for 2026-06-11 EU edge incident

Sarah — thanks again for your patience. Attached is a preliminary RCA draft (rca-draft-20260612.docx) summarizing the timeline, cause, and mitigations we applied. High-level:
- Root cause: A configuration change to the EU edge (health-check interval + rate-limit thresholds) was deployed without the rollback guard enabled. During the rollout a subset of edge pods failed health checks and were drained while traffic spikes from Lumina’s retry pattern created a retry storm, amplifying 5xx/429 responses.
- Immediate mitigation: rollback of the health-check tweak, temporary relaxation of rate-limits for Lumina, and routing of new traffic to ie-west-1.
- Remediation: add rollout safeguards, add tenant-aware gradual throttling, and run a joint Lumina/Redwood test of deployment procedures during a scheduled maintenance window.

We propose a 30-minute empathy credit for the affected production window while we complete the final postmortem and identify any billing impact. Monica will coordinate time for a walkthrough today at 16:30 UTC.

Attachments: rca-draft-20260612.docx, lb-config-diff.txt

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
